semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The Netherlands Pavilion showcases companies with diverse roles in the semiconductor value chain, including advanced packaging and semiconductor processing equipment.
summary: The Netherlands Pavilion features a collection of companies contributing to the semiconductor industry, including Boschman Advanced Packaging, which focuses on advanced packaging technology, and Tempress Systems B.V., known for its semiconductor processing equipment. Schunk Xycarb Technology provides essential materials and components for manufacturing. The pavilion also promotes collaboration between Dutch and South Korean semiconductor companies.
capabilities: Materials and components for semiconductor manufacturing

regional_presence.Netherlands: The pavilion highlights the Netherlands' role in the global semiconductor landscape, emphasizing collaboration with South Korea.
